notes: Hand-authored EN16931 UBL invoice, fictional data. Declares UNTDID 5305 code G (export outside the Community, LIVA art. 21) at 0.00 percent while printing NO counterparty country at all, which is the exact shape the guard exists to refuse: the rule table cannot place a party it cannot locate, so the document's own code would otherwise be honoured and a zero-rated supply recorded for a counterparty nobody could establish. Declared synthetic rather than sourced because no bundled fixture stated code G. The assertion is that the category is WITHHELD, never a figure recomputed from the code under test.
